The supplied URL is titled Conquests of the Longbow — The Legend of Robin Hood. It is not a walkthrough for Spellbound's The Legend of Sherwood.

The walkthrough progresses through days and adventure-game puzzles involving disguises, archery, Marian, an abbey, and a rescue. Its locations and inventory puzzle sequence belong to that separate game.

Retained because the user supplied the link and it may be useful for comparing Robin Hood adaptations. Do not use it as evidence for this repository's missions, combat, or campaign state.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: "Conquests of the Longbow - The Legend of Robin Hood (dt) Lösung / Walkthrough", a single plain-text German walkthrough credited at the end to Mogel-Power / Solution.Net; no author or date. It is the 1991 Sierra adventure, not Spellbound's game. Site content is copyrighted, so not transcribed; the structure follows below for comparison purposes.

Day-by-day flow described: breakfast at camp, archery training with Will Scarlett and new recruit Simon, lookout above Watling Street, robbing a tax collector and paying a peasant woman, visiting the widow and her three sons, a dream; day 2: Marian attacked by a black-robed monk, a lady's slipper; day 3: beggar's rags as disguise into Nottingham, Lobb the shoemaker, a silver comb; day 4: Marian at Willow Grove, the emerald, a poacher; day 5: the widow's sons imprisoned, monk's habit disguise, bribing the castle guards, three habits from the abbey laundry, the labyrinth and secret door, a keg for the pub, a game of nine men's morris for an amethyst, the pub cellar passage, drinking contest with the abbot, the abbot's box under the pillow, four pennies in the dungeon, the escape through the pub during the sheriff's party, reward of the golden net; day 6: fighting the black monk for the Fens-monk disguise, boat to the swamp monastery, riddles, the study parchment, the jester Fulk, the prior, escape; opening the box with a code from tree initials for a magic ring; Marian and the coat of arms; catching a kobold with the golden net at the old oak; the Nottingham fair (fortune teller, scarf seller, perfumer, beggars, scholars, the messenger), the archery tournament won by splitting the arrow; druid grove protection spell; jeweller disguise and audience with the sheriff (fake jewels, the emerald, the dragon hoard tale); day 10: witch burning of Marian foiled via pub, abbey, labyrinth with the fire ring; the gold convoy ambush by Tuck's plan; a fake messenger knight shot, a letter; last day: water ring, wisps, boat to the tower, ivy spell, the prisoner, code word, rockslides, escape and reward.
